{{Quote|The Chancellor has given me a very important mission. The Separatists have gathered in the Mustafar system. I'm going there to end this war. Wait for me until I return… things will be different, I promise.|Darth Vader, to Padmé Amidala|}} In the third [[Standard year|year]] of the [[Clone Wars]], [[Darth Sidious]]—the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] who was publicly known as [[Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine of the [[Galactic Republic]]—sent his [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], on a '''mission to Mustafar''' to [[Death|kill]] the [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist Council]], the wealthy and influential backers of the late [[Count]] [[Dooku]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Sidious, who secretly controlled the Separatist Alliance as part of his plot to take over [[the galaxy]], had sent the Separatist Council to the [[Magma|volcanic]] [[planet]] [[Mustafar]] under the guise of protecting them, where their power collapsed after the [[Battle of Utapau]] with the Clone Wars ending in victory for the Republic. When Vader arrived, however, he assassinated each member of the Separatist Council in order to bring an end to the Separatist rebellion and to cover up Sidious' relations with the Separatists to the general public. As Vader massacred the Separatist leaders on Mustafar, Chancellor Palpatine publicly declared himself as the galaxy's [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] and [[Proclamation of the New Order|transformed]] the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]]. Vader contacted his [[Sith Master|master]] after the Separatist leadership were killed, and the Dark Lord ordered him to shut down the [[Separatist Droid Army]]. In doing so, the defeated Confederacy ceased to meaningfully function in totality. [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], Vader's [[Marriage|wife]], soon arrived on Mustafar in an attempt to bring Vader, who had been the [[Jedi Knight]] Anakin Skywalker, back to the [[Light side of the Force|light]]. She failed, and Vader engaged in a [[lightsaber]] [[Duel on Mustafar|duel]] with [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], a fight that left Vader brutally scarred and in need of a [[Darth Vader's armor|life-supporting suit of armor]] for the rest of his life. In the years that followed, some [[Separatist holdouts|holdouts of the Confederacy]] continued to endure throughout the galaxy despite the end of the war. The [[Imperial Military]] tracked these holdouts down to destroy them and absorb their technology into the Imperial regime. ==Prelude== {{Quote|After you have killed all the Jedi in the temple, go to the Mustafar system. Wipe out Viceroy Gunray and the other Separatist leaders.|Darth Sidious, to Darth Vader|}} In [[19 BBY]], after three, nearly four, [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]],{{HelmetCollectionCite|15|Databank A-Z}} [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]—secretly [[Darth]] Sidious, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]], who controlled both factions—orchestrated his own kidnapping from [[Coruscant]], the [[capital]] [[planet]] of the Republic as part of his plot to convert Anakin to the Dark Side and have him replace Dooku as his next apprentice.{{Databank|palpatine-biography-gallery|Palpatine Biography Gallery}} The chancellor was made to appear to be the [[prison]]er of the Separatist [[Head of State]],{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}} [[Count]] [[Dooku]], a fallen [[Jedi]] and the [[Sith apprentice]] of Darth Sidious.{{Film|II}} The [[Grand Army of the Republic]], led by [[Jedi General]]s [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]], fought to rescue the chancellor during the [[Battle of Coruscant]]. The two [[Jedi]] found the chancellor on the ''[[Invisible Hand]]'', the [[command ship]] of the [[cyborg]] [[General]] [[Grievous]], where they engaged Count Dooku in a [[lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber duel|duel]]. After Skywalker got the upper hand over Dooku during the fight, he executed him under the orders of Palpatine, who had covertly betrayed and engineered the death of his apprentice. The count's loss was a major setback for the Separatist Alliance. However, Grievous and the Separatists were unaware that Sidious betrayed and orchestrated the death of Dooku. [[File:SeppyWarRoom-Ep3.png|thumb|left|300px|Nute Gunray and the other Separatist leaders as the Clone Wars draw to a close.]] The [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist Council]], comprised of wealthy and powerful corporate titans who backed Dooku and his Separatist rebellion against the Republic,{{Databank|separatist-council|Separatist Council}} gathered on the planet [[Utapau]] and awaited guidance from General Grievous in the aftermath of Dooku's death. Grievous, on the orders of Darth Sidious, told the Separatist Council that he was sending them to the [[Magma|lava]] planet of [[Mustafar]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] for their safety. [[Nute Gunray]], the [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]] of the [[Trade Federation]] and a member of the Separatist Council, expressed doubts that the cyborg general could keep them safe after Chancellor Palpatine escaped from his ship, but the council nonetheless followed the general's directive and gathered in a [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility|mining complex]] on Mustafar, where a secret command center was built onto the mining complex to serve the council,[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] while the decision to go to Mustafar was influenced by [[Arsin Crassus]], a Trade Federation employee.[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']] As the war's final [[Standard day|days]] progressed, Grievous was killed by General Kenobi during the [[Battle of Utapau]]. The defeat of Grievous resulted in the collapse of any functional command structure for the Separatist military, effectively ending the war{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}} despite the many battles still being waged across the galaxy. Meanwhile, the chancellor manipulated Skywalker towards the [[dark side of the Force]]. Skywalker, who had been having [[Force vision|visions]] of his [[Reproduction|pregnant]] [[Marriage|wife]], [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], dying in childbirth, was led to believe that the chancellor had the power to save people from death. Soon thereafter, Skywalker discovered the chancellor's [[Sith]] identity and informed Jedi Master [[Mace Windu]]. Along with three other members of the [[Jedi High Council]], Windu attempted to arrest the chancellor, leading to a [[Duel in Palpatine's office|lightsaber duel]] that left the four Jedi Masters dead. Skywalker, who betrayed Windu by helping the chancellor kill him, then betrayed the Jedi, pledged himself to Darth Sidious and was given the Sith name of Darth Vader. Sidious ordered the newly-anointed [[Sith Lord]] to [[Operation: Knightfall|attack]] the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]], and then destroy the Separatist Council on the [[Mustafar system]]. After Vader departed for the Jedi Temple, temple, Sidious issued a [[Order 66|command]] for the [[clone trooper]]s of the Grand Army of the Republic to kill their Jedi leaders, in retaliation for what the chancellor publicly stated was the Jedi Council's [[Treason|foiled attempt to assassinate him and take over the Republic]]. After the attack on the Jedi Temple, Vader headed to the [[Mustafar system]]. ==The mission== ===Beginning of the end=== {{Quote|The plan has gone as you had promised, my lord.''"
"''You have done well, Viceroy. When my new apprentice, Darth Vader, arrives, he will take care of you.|Nute Gunray and Darth Sidious|}} [[File:Sep_council_sidious.png|thumb|right|250px|The Separatist Council on Mustafar shortly before their death]] With Grievous' death at the hands of Kenobi on Utapau, Gunray now found himself as the acting [[Head of State]] of the remaining Separatist forces, and he, along with the other members of the council, continued to observe Separatist combat operations across the galaxy from the complex's command center. With the [[Great Jedi Purge|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Order]] underway across the galaxy, Vader [[pilot]]ed his [[Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor|Jedi interceptor]], accompanied by his [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]], to Mustafar to carry out his assassination orders. As he approached the mining facility, Sidious spoke to the [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]] and the rest of the Separatist leadership, which had continued to destabalize in the aftermath of Grievous' death, Gunray remarked confidently that the plan had gone just as Sidious had planned. Though the Viceroy and the others did not know that they were being betrayed by Sidious, the [[Sith Master]] deceitfully promised that his new apprentice would soon arrive to "take care of them," under the pretext of peace talks at resolving the conflict. The leadership thus was reassured and proceeded to continue monitoring the last moments of the war, unaware of their pending fate. Vader soon landed, leaving Artoo with the [[starfighter]]. ===The assassinations=== {{Quote|The war is over! Lord Sidious promised us peace. We only want—|Gunray's final words before being killed by Darth Vader|audio=NuteGunraysLastWords.flac|}} [[File:PoggleDies-ROTS.png|thumb|left|250px|Vader kills Poggle the Lesser.]] As [[Lord]] Vader arrived on Mustafar, the chancellor—deformed from [[Force lightning]] during his duel with the Jedi Council—appeared before the [[Galactic Senate]] and claimed that the Jedi had attempted to rebel against him and take over the Republic. Promising to restore peace, security, and stability after three years of war, Palpatine [[Proclamation of the New Order|proclaimed]] that the Republic was to be reorganized into the [[Galactic Empire|First Galactic Empire]], with himself as the galaxy's [[Galactic Emperor|emperor]]. The move was met with a roaring applause from the rechristened [[Imperial Senate]]. However, Padme Amidala expressed her dissatisfaction at this speech. Once the Emperor's enforcer entered the mining facility, he was greeted by Gunray and the other Confederate leaders whom sought peace with the Galactic Empire. However, the [[Sith Lord]] silently used [[the Force]] to seal the doors in the room where they were standing, ensuring that none of the Separatists could escape. Once the room was secured, Vader then began his slaughter of the Separatists, taking them out one by one with his [[Skywalker lightsaber|lightsaber]]; he also destroyed the [[OOM-series security droid]]s, an [[OOM command battle droid]], and [[Neimoidian]] [[Neimoidian Royal Guard|guards]] and aides who had assembled in the room with their commanders. In rapid succession, Vader executed the Separatists including [[Po Nudo]], [[Senator]] of the planet [[Ando]].{{Databank|po-nudo|Po Nudo}} [[File:DisneyPlusStarWarsEpisodeIIIRevengeoftheSith_Promo_Background.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Vader in the Separatist Council war room.]] Vader then killed the Neimoidian [[Rute Gunnay]], [[Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente]] of the [[Corporate Alliance]],{{Databank|passel-argente|Passel Argente}} and [[Shu Mai]], [[Presidente]] of the [[Commerce Guild]].{{Databank|shu-mai|Shu Mai}} He then set his sights on [[San Hill]], [[Chairman]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]], Senator [[Tikkes]] of [[Mon Cala]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' and [[Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser]], who had recently returned to the Separatists after defecting to the [[Republic Special Weapons Group]]. After Vader butchered Poggle, he killed [[Wat Tambor]], [[Foreman]] of the [[Techno Union]], who had fled into a conference room, and [[Settlement Officer]] [[Rune Haako]] of the [[Trade Federation]]. By the end of the massacre, only Gunray remained and attempted to flee, however Vader then jumped in front of him. The viceroy pleaded for mercy and said that Sidious promised them peace, but Vader interrupted him by cutting him down, bringing an end to the Separatist Council. ===The shutdown order=== {{Quote|The Separatists have been taken care of, my master.''"
"''It is finished, then. You have restored peace and justice to the galaxy. Send a message to the ships of the Trade Federation. All droid units must shut down immediately.''"
"''Very good, my lord.|Darth Vader and Darth Sidious after the death of the Separatist leaders.|}} [[File:TheDeathofNuteGunray.png|thumb|left|300px|Darth Vader brutally ends the three-year long Clone Wars.]] The fallen Jedi then spoke with the new emperor of the galaxy via [[hologram]] and informed his master that the Separatist leaders had been eliminated. With them out of the way, Palpatine ordered his new apprentice to transmit the order to all the Trade Federation [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|Droid Control Ships]] to deactivate all remaining [[battle droid]]s of the [[Separatist Droid Army]] immediately. This final act brought any residual fighting to an end throughout the galaxy, including [[Battle on Lokori|on]] [[Lokori]]. In doing so, the Clone Wars officially came to an end as suddenly as it had started three years prior. Thus, the new Empire had achieved a swift victory and ensuring the New Order stood unopposed. ==Aftermath== [[File:Anakinchoke.png|thumb|right|250px|Vader, enraged, telekinetically [[Force choke|strangles]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|his wife]].]] After speaking with Sidious and fulfilling his wishes, Vader saw Amidala's [[J-type Naboo star skiff|ship]] arrive on Mustafar; she secretly followed him there after Kenobi told her that Skywalker turned to the dark side. She pleaded with him to run away with her and leave their troubles behind, but Vader refused—he said he turned to protect her, and that his new power would "keep her safe" and that he could overthrow the [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] and they rule the Empire together. Though she tried to make him see reason, Vader noticed that Kenobi was standing in her [[Starship|ship]]. He too followed Vader to Mustafar, sneaking aboard Amidala's ship without her knowledge. An enraged Vader [[Force choke|attacked]] his pregnant wife and knocked her unconscious, leading to a brutal [[Duel on Mustafar|lightsaber duel]] between Vader and his former Jedi Master. Vader was horrifically mutilated in the duel and was left by Kenobi for dead, burning on the bank of a lava river. Kenobi fled with Artoo and Amidala, who secretly gave birth to [[twin]]s before dying as Vader had foreseen, while the Emperor arrived on Mustafar to tend to his wounded apprentice. Vader was forced to wear a cybernetic [[Darth Vader's armor|suit of armor]] for the rest of his life in order to survive. In the wake of the execution of Viceroy Gunray—whose execution was covered up in official records, which instead claimed he [[Death|took his own life]] after the Separatist Council realized victory was unlikely''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]''—[[Arsin Crassus]] channeled the late Separatist leadership financial resources into the coffers of the newly expanding Galactic Empire. Crassus became an important Imperial financier during the [[Imperial Era]]. Without its leadership, the Confederacy of Independent Systems collapsed''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' and broke into various [[Separatist holdouts|holdouts]], which mostly retreated to the [[Western Reaches]] that continued to exist for a number of years, some not even realizing the war was over, and carried on fighting the Empire. Most of its [[star system]]s, however, eventually surrendered to the Imperial regime and became part of the New Order after a number of [[Pacification operations in the Western Reaches|pacification operations]]. The [[Imperial Military]] saw to the dismantling of the Separatist fleets across the galaxy, such as the [[Bilbringi shipyards]], and appropriated its various droid models and technology to suit the Empire's purposes. Massive crackdowns also occurred on Confederate sentiment in order to wipe out the secessionist tendencies that had troubled the Republic. One such event was the [[Antar Atrocity]], in which [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] led Imperial forces in mass arrests, executions, and massacres on [[Antar 4]] as punishment for the [[moon]]{{'s}} support of the Separatist Alliance during the war.[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] The Galactic Empire covered up Vader's involvement in the mission, claiming that Republic agents discovered and killed the Separatist leadership. The intel about the mission remained highly classified, even [[Standard decade|decades]] after the Empire's fall.''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'' ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Conference.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Concept art for Vader's attack, by [[Ryan Church]].]] The mission to Mustafar first appeared in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the third and final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]]. In the DVD commentary of ''Revenge of the Sith'', [[George Lucas]] stated that the interwoven scenes of the Mission to Mustafar and the [[Proclamation of the New Order]] was an homage to the christening and assassination sequence of the [[1972]] classic film [[Wikipedia:The Godfather|''The Godfather'']], directed by his friend [[Wikipedia:Francis Ford Coppola|Francis Ford Coppola]].{{Film|III}} DVD commentary Originally, as outlined in a deleted scene, Sidious would have ordered Gunray and the Separatists to shut down the droid armies on their own, which Gunray then confirms is done to Sidious via hologram,{{SWYouTube|krNvSGdN2Wg|The Creatures of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith|sw_url=video/the-creatures-of-episode-iii}} instead of Vader himself carrying out the shutdown after executing the council, as is seen in the final film. A scene present in Episode III's screenplay, which didn't make it into the film, had Nute Gunray and Rune Haako hiding under a table as Darth Vader kills the Separatist Council, as seen in [[Ryan Church]]'s concept art.''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]'' Panicked, Haako attempted to flee only to die at Vader's hands as seen in the film, leading Gunray to get out from under the table and activate the control panel for the doors to open. As the remaining Separatists were killed, [[droideka]]s entered and opened fire on Vader. Gunray watched as the smoke cleared and found Vader gone. Vader then drops down from the roof and destroys the droids, after which he jumps over to Gunray and beheads him. This explains why Gunray is so surprised when Vader jumps at him—he thought he had been killed by the droids.[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode
